meta_description:
57K likes, 92 comments - dollysingh on September 26, 2026: "Most wholesome family birthday 🥹💙
Honestly our family really needed this family time and it was great to be in the midst of a jungle just talking, reminiscing, gossiping and making new memories! 🥺
BIG THANK YOU to @aaliajungle by @araiyahotels for hosting us and showing us such a wonderful time. 🥰 The stunning tents were literally feeling like my moment in those Harry Potter tents iykyk, the food was delishhhhhh and made with love and there’s so much to do around. Best thing, no mosquitoes at all! Can you imagine? 
The staff was full of the sweetest people ever and we felt so wrapped in love🥹 Its just 3.5 hrs from Delhi, just so guys know hahah 😎 Check them out💙".
